## About
LA's Custom Power and Lighting Co. works out of Lebanon Pike in Nashville and takes residential, commercial and industrial jobs across Middle Tennessee. Installation, repair, replacement and maintenance. New builds, upgrades and complex troubleshooting.
We do safe, code-compliant work, backed by decades of experience and a commitment to clean, timely work on every job. We're a Generac dealer, and we put in generators, solar power systems and marina electrical.
Customers rate us 4.6 from 66 Google reviews.

## Services
- Troubleshooting: Complex electrical problems tracked down and fixed, residential, commercial or industrial.
- Panel Changes and Service Upgrades: Panel swaps and service upgrades, with a bucket truck for overhead work.
- Generator Install: Generac dealer. Whole house generator installs and maintenance.
- Solar Power Systems: Solar and other going green services.
- Marine / Marina / Electrical Work: Electrical work for boats and marinas.
- Open Permit Closing: Help getting open electrical permits closed out.
- UL Control Panels: Control panels for commercial and industrial jobs.
- Data-Phone-Fire & Smoke Alarms: Data, phone, fire and smoke alarm wiring.

## FAQ
Q: Do you offer emergency service?
A: Yes. Call (615) 885-1124 any hour for emergency service.

Q: Do you service generators you didn't install?
A: We maintain Generac generators. Two reviewers mention maintenance visits, and one had a broken, corroded battery found and replaced.

Q: Do you work in Memphis?
A: Yes. Our Memphis line is (901) 949-0227.

Q: Do you offer senior discounts?
A: Yes. We offer senior citizen discounts. Ask when you call.
